name: Starve the Fire
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level alchemist 2, druid 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot aura
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create an area where fire is weakened. All fire-based lights decreased their bright and dim radii by 10 feet. All fire-based spells and effects decrease their DC by 1 for those affected within the aura. Additionally, all fire damage dealt within the radius is decreased by 1 per dice of fire damage dealt, or by 1 if no dice are used. Finally, any creature with the fire subtype is fatigued. If they are immune to fatigue, they instead take a -1 penalty to their attack and damage rolls.
